cases.prompt: Set up this fresh Laravel project with the deterministic Pest 5 development toolchain.
assertions: Checks PHP, Laravel, sockets, Composer, Node.js, and npm compatibility before mutation
Installs all requested non-Boost packages in one Composer transaction with Pest constrained to 5.x
Configures Pest, Playwright, Larastan, Pest PHPStan, Rector, Pint, PAO, and Ray
Installs Laravel Boost last and leaves boost:install for the user

cases.prompt: Finish this Laravel development setup; some Pest and PHPStan configuration already exists.
assertions: Inspects and preserves existing test, PHPStan, Rector, Pint, and Composer script conventions
Adds only missing package constraints, extensions, paths, and scripts
Surfaces conflicting script semantics for user resolution
Verifies the final locked dependency graph and full quality gate

cases.prompt: Install the Pest 5 Laravel setup in this Laravel 12 project running PHP 8.3.
assertions: Reports the PHP 8.4 and Laravel 13.23 compatibility requirements
Does not bypass platform requirements or downgrade requested packages
